verses.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס לִכְל֥וֹת דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֑ה הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ ר֙וּחַ֙ כֹּ֣רֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פָּרַ֔ס וַיַּֽעֲבֶר־ קוֹל֙ בְּכָל־ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְגַם־ בְּמִכְתָּ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·naṯ ’a·ḥaṯ lə·ḵō·w·reš me·leḵ pā·ras liḵ·lō·wṯ də·ḇar- Yah·weh mip·pî yir·mə·yāh hê·‘îr Yah·weh ’eṯ- rū·aḥ kō·reš me·leḵ- pā·ras way·ya·‘ă·ḇer- qō·wl bə·ḵāl mal·ḵū·ṯōw wə·ḡam- bə·miḵ·tāḇ lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation throughout his kingdom and to put it in writing as follows
verses.literalPt: NO primeiro ano de Ciro, rei da Pérsia (para que se cumprisse a palavra do SENHOR, pela boca de Jeremias), despertou o SENHOR o espírito de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, o qual fez passar pregão por todo o seu reino, como também por escrito, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֗ר כֹּ֚רֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס כֹּ֚ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ נָ֣תַן לִ֔י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֽוּא־ פָקַ֤ד עָלַי֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar kō·reš me·leḵ pā·ras kōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ nā·ṯan lî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haš·šā·mā·yim wə·hū- p̄ā·qaḏ ‘ā·lay liḇ·nō·wṯ- lōw ḇa·yiṯ bî·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer bî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: This is what Cyrus king of Persia says The LORD the God of heaven who has given me all the kingdoms of the earth has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Ciro, rei da Pérsia: O SENHOR Deus dos céus me deu todos os reinos da terra, e me encarregou de lhe edificar uma casa em Jerusalém, que está em Judá.

verses.original: מִֽי־ בָכֶ֣ם מִכָּל־ עַמּ֗וֹ יְהִ֤י אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וְיַ֕עַל לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּיהוּדָ֑ה וְיִ֗בֶן אֶת־ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ה֥וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mî- ḇā·ḵem mik·kāl ‘am·mōw yə·hî ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘im·mōw wə·ya·‘al lî·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer bî·hū·ḏāh wə·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Whoever among you belongs to His people may his God be with him and may he go to Jerusalem in Judah and build the house of the LORD the God of Israel He is the God who is in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Quem há entre vós, de todo o seu povo, seja seu Deus com ele, e suba a Jerusalém, que está em Judá, e edifique a casa do SENHOR Deus de Israel (ele é o Deus) que está em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנִּשְׁאָ֗ר מִֽכָּל־ הַמְּקֹמוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר ה֣וּא גָֽר־ שָׁם֒ יְנַשְּׂא֙וּהוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מְקֹמ֔וֹ בְּכֶ֥סֶף וּבְזָהָ֖ב וּבִרְכ֣וּשׁ וּבִבְהֵמָ֑ה עִם־ הַ֨נְּדָבָ֔ה לְבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·niš·’ār mik·kāl ham·mə·qō·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer hū ḡār- šām yə·naś·śə·’ū·hū ’an·šê mə·qō·mōw bə·ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḇə·zā·hāḇ ū·ḇir·ḵūš ū·ḇiḇ·hê·māh ‘im- han·nə·ḏā·ḇāh lə·ḇêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And let every survivor wherever . . . he lives . . . be assisted by the men of that region with silver gold goods and livestock along with a freewill offering for the house of God in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E todo aquele que ficar atrás em algum lugar em que andar peregrinando, os homens do seu lugar o ajudarão com prata, com ouro, com bens, e com gados, além das dádivas voluntárias para a casa de Deus, que está em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיָּק֜וּמוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֗וֹת לִֽיהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְכֹ֨ל הֵעִ֤יר הָאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ רוּח֔וֹ לַעֲל֣וֹת לִבְנ֔וֹת אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qū·mū rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lî·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim lə·ḵōl hê·‘îr hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- rū·ḥōw la·‘ă·lō·wṯ liḇ·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: So the family heads of Judah and Benjamin along with the priests and Levites everyone whose spirit God had stirred prepared to go up and rebuild the house of the LORD in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Então se levantaram os chefes dos pais de Judá e Benjamim, e os sacerdotes e os levitas, com todos aqueles cujo espírito Deus despertou, para subirem a edificar a casa do SENHOR, que está em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְכָל־ סְבִיבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ חִזְּק֣וּ בִֽידֵיהֶ֔ם בִּכְלֵי־ כֶ֧סֶף בַּזָּהָ֛ב בָּרְכ֥וּשׁ וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה וּבַמִּגְדָּנ֑וֹת לְבַ֖ד עַל־ כָּל־ הִתְנַדֵּֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·hem ḥiz·zə·qū ḇî·ḏê·hem biḵ·lê- ḵe·sep̄ baz·zā·hāḇ bā·rə·ḵūš ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh ū·ḇam·miḡ·dā·nō·wṯ lə·ḇaḏ ‘al- kāl- hiṯ·nad·dêḇ
verses.literal: And all their neighbors supported them with articles of silver and gold with goods and livestock and with valuables in addition to all their freewill offerings
verses.literalPt: E todos os que habitavam nos arredores lhes firmaram as mãos com vasos de prata, com ouro, com bens e com gado, e com coisas preciosas; além de tudo o que voluntariamente se deu.

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ כּ֔וֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִ֖יא אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י בֵית־ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֤יא נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ kō·w·reš hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- kə·lê ḇêṯ- Yah·weh ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣî nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mî·rū·šā·lim way·yit·tə·nêm bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: King Cyrus also brought out the articles belonging to the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem and placed in the temple of his gods
verses.literalPt: Também o rei Ciro tirou os utensílios da casa do SENHOR, que Nabucodonosor tinha trazido de Jerusalém, e que tinha posto na casa de seus deuses.

verses.original: וַיּֽוֹצִיאֵ֗ם כּ֚וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס עַל־ יַ֖ד מִתְרְדָ֣ת הַגִּזְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּסְפְּרֵם֙ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֔ר הַנָּשִׂ֖יא לִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ṣī·ʾēm kō·w·reš me·leḵ pā·ras ‘al- yaḏ miṯ·rə·ḏāṯ hag·giz·bār way·yis·pə·rêm lə·šê·šə·baṣ·ṣar han·nā·śî lî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Cyrus king of Persia had them brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah
verses.literalPt: Estes tirou Ciro, rei da Pérsia, pela mão de Mitredate, o tesoureiro, que os entregou contados a Sesbazar, príncipe de Judá.

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה מִסְפָּרָ֑ם אֲגַרְטְלֵ֨י זָהָ֜ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֗ים אֲגַרְטְלֵי־ כֶ֙סֶף֙ אָ֔לֶף מַחֲלָפִ֖ים תִּשְׁעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh mis·pā·rām ’ă·ḡar·ṭə·lê zā·hāḇ šə·lō·šîm ’ă·ḡar·ṭə·lê- ḵe·sep̄ ’ā·lep̄ ma·ḥă·lā·p̄îm tiš·‘āh wə·‘eś·rîm
verses.literal: This was the inventory 30 gold dishes 1,000 silver dishes 29 . . . silver utensils
verses.literalPt: E este é o número deles: trinta travessas de ouro, mil travessas de prata, vinte e nove facas,

verses.original: כְּפוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֔ים כְּפ֤וֹרֵי כֶ֙סֶף֙ מִשְׁנִ֔ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַעֲשָׂרָ֑ה כֵּלִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·p̄ō·w·rê zā·hāḇ šə·lō·šîm kə·p̄ō·w·rê ḵe·sep̄ miš·nîm ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ wa·‘ă·śā·rāh kê·lîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: 30 gold bowls 410 . . . . . . matching silver bowls and 1,000 other articles
verses.literalPt: Trinta bacias de ouro, mais outras quatrocentas e dez bacias de prata, e mil outros utensílios.

verses.original: כָּל־ כֵּלִים֙ לַזָּהָ֣ב וְלַכֶּ֔סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֑וֹת הַכֹּ֞ל הֶעֱלָ֣ה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֗ר עִ֚ם הֵעָל֣וֹת הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מִבָּבֶ֖ל לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- kê·lîm laz·zā·hāḇ wə·lak·ke·sep̄ ḥă·mê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ hak·kōl he·‘ĕ·lāh šê·šə·baṣ·ṣar ‘im hê·‘ā·lō·wṯ hag·gō·w·lāh mib·bā·ḇel lî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: In all, there were 5,400 . . . . . . . . . gold and silver articles Sheshbazzar brought all these along when the exiles went up from Babylon to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Todos os utensílios de ouro e de prata foram cinco mil e quatrocentos; todos estes levou Sesbazar, quando os do cativeiro subiram de Babilônia para Jerusalém.
